_comment: Services declared on machines the hub does not run — a NAS's Samba, an HTTP server, a plain TCP port — managed from the Services page. The hub probes each one for health and publishes it to devices. No secrets live here: a share's login is typed on the machine that mounts it.
_comment_fields: Each entry: id (panel-assigned uuid), name, kind (samba | http | generic_tcp), host, port, description, created_at. An http entry adds scheme (http | https) and path; a samba entry adds shares, each {name}. The list ships empty; the panel fills it.
